subject: Physics
question: A radioactive sample has a half-life of 8.0 days and an initial activity of 640 Bq. Calculate its activity after 24 days and the fraction of the original nuclei that remain.
response_text:
Number of half-lives: n = t/T½ = 24/8.0 = 3
Activity after 3 half-lives: A = 640 × (½)³ = 640/8 = 80 Bq
Fraction remaining: (½)³ = 1/8 = 0.125

After three half-lives one-eighth of the nuclei remain undecayed, so the activity has fallen to 80 Bq.

correct_steps: one-eighth of the nuclei remain undecayed, so the activity has fallen to 80 Bq
